name: Geberit AG
summary: Geberit AG develops, produces, and distributes sanitary products and systems for the residential and commercial construction industry. It offers installation and flushing systems, such as installation technology and flushing systems for toilets, including cisterns and interior fittings; and piping systems comprising building drainage and supply systems, as well as piping technology for use in buildings for drinking water, heating, gas, and other media. The company also provides bathroom system products that include bathroom ceramics, furniture, showers, bathtubs, taps and controls, and shower toilets.
